svg.title: Dai Kenja — Doctrine of Overflow. Draft 4 / Dai Kenja classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Brimming Cup forks into Chakra Surcharge then Breaking Point, or Flooded Meridians then Boundless Reservoir. Sage's Rebuke forks into Smothered Current then Edict of Silence, or Cracked Vessel then Shattered Vessel. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Dai Kenja jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Overloaded Impact carries the only Damage row (40 power at level 25) and the only Increase Damage Given row (30% self, Ninjutsu filter with no element, so it also admits every non-elemental hit; live only in the two rounds after the cast, so it never helps its own hit), making offense through that cast the primary in two separate forms: more power on the hit, or a stronger amplifier for the hits that follow; the bloodline's 15% passive multiplies under the same matching. Decrease Damage Given is the broadest tag (25% on Chakra Overload, 30% on the AOE Chakra Cannon, all stat types) and is secondary, so root B holds the heavier four-purchase builds by row weight (19\u201324 against 13\u201315 on root A) while root A holds the largest single-row flats (+6 Damage, +10 Increase Damage Given). Increase Damage Taken reaches Chakra Overload's 35% enemy exposure but also the adverse 25% self exposure on Overloaded Impact, so it is a small, explicitly accepted tertiary route; Chakra Cannon's pierce and Chakra Overload's pool-cost row are unsupported and untouched."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Brimming Cup","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":3,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"A sage's chakra fills the cup past its rim and keeps pouring.","coverage_note":"Overloaded Impact self damage buff (30\u219233%); adds to Ninjutsu or non-elemental hits in the 2 rounds after each cast, never its own hit.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Dai Kenja","scope":"Dai Kenja jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Overloaded Impact"],"effect_rows":1}},{"id":"02","name":"Chakra Surcharge","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":3,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"Every impact carries more than the body was meant to hold.","coverage_note":"Overloaded Impact Damage only (40\u219243 power); single row, 60 AP, cooldown 6, single target at range 4. Vessel"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split mirrors the kit's two sides. Brimming Cup (self) opens Overloaded Impact, forking into raw power (Chakra Surcharge \u2192 Breaking Point) and self buff (Flooded Meridians \u2192 Boundless Reservoir); Sage's Rebuke (enemy) opens Chakra Overload / Chakra Cannon, forking into suppression (Smothered Current \u2192 Edict of Silence) and exposure (Cracked Vessel \u2192 Shattered Vessel). Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep. Boundless Reservoir and Edict are single-tag: their roots hold no second non-adverse tag.","Flats scale with coverage. Damage reaches one row (Overloaded Impact 40): +3/+3 (max 46 power), not the reference's +2/+3 over three rows. Increase Damage Given is one 30% self row: single-row ladder +3/+3/+4 (max 40%). Decrease Damage Given has two enemy rows that stack on one target (25%, 30%): +2/+2/+4 (max +8: 33/38%, 71% combined). Increase Damage Taken has one enemy and one adverse self row: one route at +2/+3 (max +5). Per-tag maxima are within guardrails and not jointly attainable.","Timing (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b): Overloaded Impact's self buff is inert in its cast round (adjustDamageGiven skips new or cast-this-round effects, tags.ts 925; flags clear at round advance, util.ts 2567\u20132577), so it never touches its own hit, and cooldown 6 outlives it. In the two rounds after the cast the enhanced 33\u201340% adds that share of the staged base to every Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit (getEfficiencyRatio, tags.ts 3477\u20133510). Only the 15% bloodline passive multiplies.","Delivery and uptime: Overloaded Impact is 60 AP, cooldown 6, one single-target hit at range 4; its buff and self exposure live two rounds in every six. Chakra Overload is 40 AP single target, cooldown 6; Chakra Cannon a 60 AP AOE circle, cooldown 7. Both suppression debuffs sit on one target only when the casts land in the same or consecutive rounds (100 AP in all), so 71% is a ceiling. Ranked PvP and ranked sparring suppress tree effects. Nothing was simulated.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Sage's Rebuke (27/32%) or Flooded Meridians (buff 38%); Amplifier, Sage's Rebuke or Chakra Surcharge (43 power); Suppression, Brimming Cup (buff 33%) or Cracked Vessel (exposure 37%, self 27%); Exposure, Smothered Current or Brimming Cup. Counting IDT as a gain, 13 of 14 full builds are non-dominated; IDT-neutral, 8 are and neither Vessel node appears, so Cracked Vessel earns its place as the Shattered Vessel gate. Adverse-aware dominance is tooling debt.","Tuning for review (OPEN_DECISIONS D11; values user-owned, unchanged): Shattered Vessel is the largest node (raw 6, row-weighted 12, 9 without the adverse row) against Edict of Silence 4/8, Breaking Point 5/5 and Boundless Reservoir 4/4; its full build scores 24 (19 without the adverse row; 4.0 per row vs Taiyo Kami's 3.4) while root A's score 13\u201315. Options: cut Shattered Vessel's DDG secondary to +2 (Exposure build 31/36%) or raise Edict of Silence to +5 (max DDG +9)."],"risks":["Adverse row accepted (D11): IDT nodes also raise Overloaded Impact's self exposure (all damage; 27% Cracked Vessel, 30% Shattered Vessel) in the two rounds after each cast, atop the 5% IDT passive. Only the exposure route has the tag; the enemy row (Chakra Overload, Ninjutsu or non-elemental, 35\u219240%) needs its own 40 AP cast. Fallback: drop Shattered Vessel, keep Cracked Vessel as a leaf (max +2).","Ally hazard (Chakra Cannon#1; warning kept): Cannon is an OTHER_USER AOE circle with friendlyFire ALL, so an ally in the circle (never the caster) gets its two-round suppression at the enhanced 32\u201338% (actions.ts 1029\u20131060; process.ts 154\u2013183); every DDG node raises it; positioning decides. Chakra Overload's DDG is ENEMIES-only; its ALL exposure row lands on an ally only if aimed at one.","Single-cast concentration: all five root-A nodes modify Overloaded Impact only (one 60 AP single-target cast, cooldown 6). The Burst route adds +6 power to one hit per cycle; the Amplifier route pays only on Ninjutsu or non-elemental hits landed in the two rounds after that cast, never on the cast's own hit.","Suppression stacking: Chakra Overload and Chakra Cannon apply separate two-round Decrease Damage Given debuffs; with BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on, every same-tag effect applies and the percentages add (process.ts 1109\u20131117), so one target's hits lose 55% of their staged base at baseline and 71% at the route maximum, more with an allied Dai Kenja. Flats were cut to +2/+2/+4 for this; not simulated.","Leakage: the self buff adds to every Ninjutsu or non-elemental hit the caster lands in the two rounds after its cast (normal jutsu, basic attacks, weapons); enemy-side suppression and exposure alter damage from allies and weapons too. Restricted casting scope does not restrict downstream benefit; stat filters on element-less rows are not binding (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73, getEfficiencyRatio).","Classification: no row in this kit carries an element, so the proposed 'Dai Kenja' label is a bloodline-keyed extension with no existing element to fall back on. Under the current resolver all 6 supported rows fall back to None, which would also reach every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts; the normal-jutsu collision is unverified. The tree is inert until that extension exists.","Unsupported rows: Chakra Cannon's pierce (58 at level 25) and Chakra Overload's increasepoolcost (100%) receive no bonus; because pierce is processed after the damage-modifier pass at the pin, the Amplifier and Exposure routes do not raise the pierce hit and the Suppression route does not reduce enemy pierce.","Rank context: Dai Kenja is a D-rank bloodline with B/C/A-rank jutsu, weaker unmodified than the A-rank reference; the tree equalises marginal opportunity, not final strength, and cross-bloodline comparison is deferred to the roster review. Normal-tree potency policy is not approved, so a combined stacking audit is required before implementation. g.text: Draft 4 / Dai Kenja classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Dai Kenja jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Edict of Silence path + Brimming Cup
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
